purpose: Continue the active offline three-session research goal after Campaign123 terminal by reviewing a finite low-entitlement point-in-time source catalog before any Campaign124 provider row, factor value, comparator value, price, or return is opened.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: ipo_retail_ballot_scarcity_20to79s
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The documented ballot field is a prelisting retail allocation-success rate. Lower ballot identifies stronger subscription scarcity before secondary-market trading and is neither a price path nor a high-entitlement order-flow source.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: raw_listing_or_ipo_age
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Listing age, IPO cohort and age buckets were already consumed and terminalized by Campaign075. The new factor may use a frozen eligibility/support window but may not rank age.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: ipo_price_pe_or_valuation_discount
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Issue price and PE reopen price/valuation and affordability families and require a benchmark choice. They are not needed to identify subscription scarcity.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: ipo_amount_market_amount_funds_or_float_scarcity
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Issue size, online amount and funds are size/free-float/capital-raising states already adjacent to terminal size, free-float and financing mechanisms.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: stock_hsgt_membership_change
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The current official stock_hsgt page states that data begins on 2025-08-12, so it cannot support the frozen 2019-2023 expanding development folds.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: legacy_hs_const_inclusion_history
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Third-party SDK indexes describe historical in/out dates, but the current official directory has replaced that interface and does not provide a current complete 2019-2023 contract. Third-party schema memory is insufficient authorization for provider rows.

selected_candidate.name: ipo_retail_ballot_scarcity_20to79s
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: Among stocks that have passed the frozen 20-session listing eligibility gate but remain within their first 79 listed sessions, a lower IPO online-subscription success rate represents stronger prelisting retail demand scarcity that may persist into near-term price discovery.
